Shanghai Municipal Police.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 57
Date. 13. 2. 29.
I.O. CHINESE SECTION. Station.
February 22nd, 1929.
REPORT ON INFLAMMATORY LITERATURE.
Made by O.D.I. Prince. Forwarded by J.Kivens A.C.M.
Reference to the attached inquiries shew that the
Lee Chuan (勵羣社) book-store was established some four
months ago, and was reported closed up again on February
9th, 1929. (Chinese New Year Eve). This book-store, which
was situated at No. 142 Changsha Road, in the vicinity of
Kuling Road, published a Communistic Book entitled Hyoeh Zau
(血潮), "The Tide of Blood" at the above address, where
the proprietor of the book-store one (Zau) (印), a native
of Shanghai, was a sub-tenant. The chief tenant being one
Tau Sah (杜碩), a cotton dealer.
Although the Lee Chuan (勵羣) book-store is
reported to be closed up there are reasons to believe that
the man Zau (印) is still carrying on his business,
though repeated attempts to purchase, or obtain a copy of
the book mentioned, from him, or book-stores in this Settle-
ment, have been in vain.
Reference to the Chou Tou (決鬥社) Society mentioned
in attached inquiries, so far, have failed to locate this
society in Canton Road, or vicinity, and inquiries at book-
stores and agencies have failed to discover a copy of the
periodical mentioned, Chou Tou (決鬥) on sale.
Mr Dayan & P. Bzl. You Judgt?
Newark with the quite full

6/3.
Jule Rea
10/3.

051
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事检举登记处
编号 I. O. D. 57
日期：29年2月13日。
情报官 华务股。 警署。
1929年2月22日。
关于煽动性刊物的报告。
由 O.D.I. Prince 撰写。经 J.Kivens 助理总巡官转呈。
参照所附查询事项显示，
励羣社书店于约四个月前成立，据报已于1929年2月9日（农历除夕）再次关闭。该书店位于古岭路（Kuling Road）附近的长沙路142号，在上述地址出版了一本名为 Hyoeh Zau（血潮），即《血潮》的共产主义书籍，书店店主为一名姓 (Zau) (印) 的上海籍人士，其为二房东。大房东为一名叫 Tau Sah (杜碩) 的棉商。
虽然据报励羣社书店已关闭，但有理由相信此人 Zau (印) 仍在继续经营其业务，尽管多次尝试从他或本租界内的书店购买或获取上述提及的书籍副本，均未成功。
关于所附查询中提到的 Chou Tou (決鬥社) 社团，截至目前，未能在广东路或其附近找到该社团，且在书店及代理机构进行的查询也未能发现提及的期刊 Chou Tou (決鬥) 有售。

pages.en:
ORDER
From The National Government to The Shanghai Provisional Court.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 51
Date 20. 2. 29）

We have received the following despatch from the Civil
Office of this Government stating,
"We have received a despatch from the Scretary of the
Central Executive Committee, to the effect that a despatch
reading as follows has been received from the Central Propaganda
Department,
"We have discovered that editorials which appeared in the
periodical styled "Chou Tou" published by the Chou Tou Society
advocate reconstruction of the Kuomintang. The discussion is
absurd and detrimental, therefore its issuance should be prohi-
bited. As the Society is situated in Canton Road, Shanghai, we
most humbly request you to inform the National Government to
order The Provisional Court of the Shanghai Special Municipality
and the Shanghai and Woosung Gendarmerie to prohibit the
periodical from further circulation and also to order the
Shanghai Provisional Court to seal up the premises of that
Society. Attached, please find a copy of the periodical."
"In accordance with the request we are informing you
to act accordingly."
Wherefore this order is issued and we hope that it may
be duly executed.
Dated the 9th day of February, 1929.
(Sd) Chiang Kai Shek etc.

A.C. (Pol)
Enquire please
20/2 Hsi

Chinese Section,
For careful inquiry and
report please.
J.K.
20.2.29.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事检举登记处
编号 I. O. D. 51
日期 29年2月20日）

我们收到本政府民政厅发出的如下公函称，
“我们收到中央执行委员会秘书长的公函，内容如下，即收到中央宣传部的公函，内容如下，
‘我们发现由 Chou Tou 社出版的名为《Chou Tou》的期刊中出现的社论主张改组国民党。该论述荒谬且有害，因此应禁止其发行。鉴于该社位于上海广东路，我们恳请贵方知会国民政府，命令上海特别市临时法院及上海与吴淞宪兵队禁止该期刊继续流通，并命令上海临时法院查封该社场所。随函附上该期刊副本一份。’
‘依照该请求，现通知贵方采取相应行动。’”
特此发布此令，望能 duly 执行。
1929年2月9日。
(签名) 蒋介石 等。

A.C. (Pol)
请查询
20/2 Hsi

华务股，
请仔细调查并
报告。
J.K.
29.2.20.

pages.en:
DESPATCH
From The Education Bureau of the Shanghai Special Municipality
To The Shanghai Provisional Court.

We, the Education Bureau, have received a mandate (No. 3355).
from the Shanghai Municipal Government stating,
"We have received an order from the National Government
stating that they had received a despatch from the Secretary of
the Central Executive Committee, to the effect that a despatch
reading as follows has been received from the Central Propaganda
Department,
"We were informed by the Propaganda Department of the
Directorate of the Peping Kuomintang that they have discovered
a reactionary periodical called "Shu Zau" and we were requested
to prohibit its publication and circulation. We have found out
that the periodical is published by Communists, therefore its
issuance should be suppressed. We most humbly request you to
inform the National Government to prohibit its sale and also to
order the Shanghai Provisional Court to seal up the Lee Chun Book
Store, the publisher of the periodical."
"Order has been duly received from the said authorities. We
were ordered to prohibit its selling within our district and in
case of any book store being discovered of selling the said
prohibited books, the store shall be sealed up. We therefore
order you to investigate the case and execute the order accordingly
We have sent our men to discuss with you. We have also
ordered them to make investigations. We were reported that the
store is situated at 142 Kuling Road.. Two copies of "Shu Zau"
were bought and sent to you. Wherefore we sincerely hope that
the order may be duly executed by you and favour us a reply.
Dated the 4th day of February 1929.
(Sd) Wei Kou
pages.zh:
公函
发自上海特别市教育局 至 上海临时法院。

我局收到上海市政府发来的指令（第3355号），内容如下，
“我们收到国民政府的命令，称其收到中央执行委员会秘书长的公函，内容如下，即收到中央宣传部的公函，内容如下，
‘我们接到北平国民党指导委员会宣传部通知，称发现一种名为《Shu Zau》的反动期刊，并要求我们禁止其出版和流通。经查，该期刊由共产党人出版，因此应予以取缔。我们恳请贵方知会国民政府禁止其销售，并命令上海临时法院查封该期刊的出版商 Lee Chun 书店。’
‘已正式收到上述当局的命令。我们奉命禁止在其辖区内销售该书，若发现任何书店销售上述禁书，该店将被查封。因此，我们命令贵方调查此案并据此执行命令。
我们已派人前来与贵方商议。我们也已命令他们进行调查。据报该店位于古岭路142号。两本《Shu Zau》已被购买并送交贵方。因此，我们真诚希望贵方能 duly 执行该命令，并赐复。’
1929年2月4日。
(签名) Wei Kou

公函

发自：上海特别市教育局
致：上海临时法院。

本局接获上海市政府第3335号指令，内称：
“本府接获国民政府命令，称其收到中央执行委员会秘书处的公函，该函转达了来自中央宣传部的如下公函内容：
‘据国民党北平指导部宣传部告知，该部发现一种名为《四赞》的反动期刊，并要求禁止其出版与发行。经查，该期刊系由共产党人出版，故应予以查禁。兹恳请贵府转呈国民政府禁止其销售，并命令上海临时法院查封该期刊的出版机构——立成书局。’
‘上述当局的命令已 duly 收悉。本府奉令禁止在其辖区内销售该期刊，若发现任何书店销售上述禁书，即予查封。因此，本府命令你方调查此案，并据此执行命令。本府已派员与你方商洽，并亦命令其进行调查。据报，该书店位于古岭路142号。现购得《四赞》两册，送交你方。故此，诚望你方 duly 执行命令，并惠予复函。
日期：1939年2月4日。

（签名）魏寇

（批注：应为
长沙路
142号）
